title: ClearPath Tenure and the Handling Charge on Re-Issued Network and Server Quotes
content:
The re-issue handling charge on a re-issued Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that lapsed unsigned follows the client's ClearPath tenure: the whole months from the go-live date of its active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement to the re-issue day, a month completing only once the day of the month reaches the go-live date's day number.

| ClearPath tenure on the re-issue day | Re-issue handling charge |
|---|---|
| at least 48 whole months | nothing |
| at least 24 and fewer than 48 whole months | 20.00 USD |
| fewer than 24 whole months, or no active ClearPath agreement | the order type's handling fee: 35.00 USD on a Network Equipment Order, 75.00 USD on a Server & Storage Build Order |

**Counting, worked (hypothetical dates).** An agreement that went live on 12 February of one year has 23 whole months on 11 February two years later, and the order type's handling fee applies; on 12 February two years later it has 24 whole months and the charge is 20.00. On 12 February four years after go-live it reaches 48 whole months and nothing is charged.

The go-live date is the one on the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.
